author: shad364
body:
This might just be a little rant, you can lock it if you want but this needs to be seriously looked at. Recently... well not recently but over a course of a few months after playing on Walls I have realised how disgusting the walls community it.

I will not name and shame

They are not  humble losers and they cannot accept defeat. I have seen how others act on Nexus, they seem friendly enough the times I was on it.

However the people on Walls are: rude, negative, bullies and just plain anti-social and its horrible to see such a good game be ruined by the people on it.

I speak of it in ways such as how people decide to play the game. Some do offence and some do defense. The people who enjoy defense who aren't good at direct PvP but are good archers get the short stick in this game. They are constantly belittled and bullied for not running head first into a fight. Furthermore others encourage them to degrade common human decency and push the initiators into swearing, shouting and bullying the other players.

Not all of this is negative though. There are some people who try to stop or prevent the arguing and fighting happening but over all the countless people degrading and hurting others it isn't seen.

Thank you for reading this and I would like to finish this off with either more active mods (considering how many new junior mods have been assigned, this problem is decreasing but still majorly exists) or the fact that being an initiator of negative bahaviour can be punishable...

title: Walls Community

replies.author: FamingRainicorn
replies.body:
I completely agree with this. There is a reason people don't enjoy playing walls anymore and I think this is it. I don't enjoy being bullied when I'm in game and I know others don't enjoy it either. Well... No one does.
I confronted one person about it during a game and their only response was 'Well people who don't play correctly deserve it.' 
There is no correct way to play and in all honesty the reason that person gave was disgusting. Claiming people 'deserve' to be bullied is what is wrong with the walls society.
It's despicable and needs to be seen to and dealt with productively.

replies.author: shad364
replies.body:
True but Id like to think of it as disgusting in a way I can only describe by an analogy:

Imagine the community is like a ferrero rocher (http://2.bp.blogspot.com/_CT01MPvpdJc/THudzm-WHJI/AAAAAAAAACw/hWY1O0uidEE/s1600/1700-Ferrero-Rocher-...)

On the exterior, from what you see if the rough messy coating of nuts which would be what people would see as the negative people...

But if you open it up all the gooey delicious-ness inside is found... this would be all the nice and supporting people. But if you look at the exterior alone a lot of judgements can be made before you even go fully into it, e.g. playing many games of Walls to realise that there are really nice people

I hope my delicious chocolate analogy helped <3

replies.body: I don't think that the community is disgusting, but what I can say is that if you like to play walls uniquely and the style of play is winning games, you will be criticised by the people who think you hack or think you are camping or whatever. I know sky bases are a particularly infamous strategy, but if they want to build a sky base, please don't attack them with insults.

replies.author: FrozenThorn
replies.body:
I agree with Cupcake, spending a lot of time mining and getting resources then getting killed can make you rage but I guess it is part of the fun of the game.

I think that people also do not play Walls so much because there aren't as many maps for Walls as there are for other game modes such as Nexus or Nebula; this is due to the fact that people play on Nebula and Nexus more, therefore new maps are constantly being brought out so players do not get bored.

This is all one big spiral really that will be difficult to get out of. People don't play Walls for various reasons, such as mine and then go and find a different game mode. Maybe more maps for Walls should be created to attract players to it.

If people are being rude in game repetitively then please don't hesitate to use /report, if a Moderator or any other member of staff is on, they should soon make their way to your game to see what is going on!

Thank you for this post!
